I first started reading the series after buying ''[[The Eye of the World]]'' in an introductory reprint in 2000, and although I was never big on a lot of fantasy works, ''The Wheel of Time'' really managed to catch my interest.

I'm currently on what I think it my fourth re-read of the series in eager anticipation of the release of ''[[Knife of Dreams]]'' in paperback in November.  I was trying to time it so I'd finish ''[[Crossroads of Twilight]]'' about the last week of November, but I'm plowing my way through them quicker than I expected.  Oops.

More than anything I'll probably find myself editing for spelling and grammar issues...  Although props to [[User:Gherald]] for fixing the capitalization in the first paragraph above.  Hey, I never claimed to be infallible.  Yet.  ;)
